content: MediaMetadataRetriever frame extraction: getFrameAtTime with OPTION_CLOSEST has large per-call overhead (decodes to exact frame, seek per call) - looping it over hundreds of timestamps is very slow (community benchmarks: tens of seconds for a few seconds of video). Official reference recommends getFramesAtIndex/getFrameAtIndex for consecutive frames. For fixed-rate batch sampling (4 fps), driving FFmpeg itself (-vf fps=4 to files) avoids JVM bitmap churn entirely.
